'''Castle Wars''' is a [[minigame]] released by [[Jagex]] in December 2004. It is similar to {{wp|Capture the Flag}}, but with a ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'' twist. On [[20 July]] [[2017]], it was made [[free-to-play]], and can be accessed via a portal in the [[Ferox Enclave]].
